answer: Make the fake cost more than the fraud is worth. Contractor licence with building authority attestation does that with a licence number in the building authority register. The pearl of the scheme is the asymmetry: verification takes seconds and costs nothing, while fabrication takes years and costs a fortune. One fake is a rounding error; a thousand is a business losing money on every unit, and the violet in each unit is a real person doing real things in the real world. The river that seals the gate is the audit trail - it remembers every payment, and it does not forget.
